refresh_policy.rationale: Collection reads the activity list that strava.com loads for the owner's own signed-in session. A live session refreshes without a prompt; the first run and an expired session need the owner to sign in through the browser handoff. The first run inventories all activity summaries. Later runs discover new summaries and read at most 100 activity details from a resumable queue. Pages and details are fetched one at a time with pauses.

streams.name: activities
streams.description: Activities read from the owner's signed-in strava.com activity list. The initial inventory emits summaries; later runs can enrich them from activity detail pages, heartrate streams and gear lists. Emitted records exclude routes, GPS coordinates, activity titles and notes.

display.label: Your Strava activities
display.detail: Sport, start time, distance, moving and elapsed time, elevation gain, average and maximum heart rate, calories and gear. No route, no GPS coordinates, no activity titles or notes.

id.description: Strava's numeric activity ID, used as the record's primary key.

activity_type.description: Strava's coarse activity type, such as Ride, Run, Swim or Hike, or null when unavailable. A collector may map a finer sport type to its coarse activity type.

start_date.description: The YYYY-MM-DD date portion of start_time, inheriting start_time_basis. A UTC or unknown-basis date does not establish the athlete's local calendar day; use start_date_local for local-day filtering and joins.

start_date_local.description: The athlete's local calendar day, YYYY-MM-DD, or null when it cannot be determined from the collected source. This is the consent_time_field: a time_range compares calendar days, and a bounded run excludes activities whose local day is unavailable.

start_time.description: Activity start in ISO-8601 form. Depending on the collected source, it may carry a UTC offset or be zoneless. Read start_time_basis before treating it as an instant or making local time-of-day claims.

start_time_basis.description: The clock used for start_time: 'local', 'utc' or 'unknown', recording what the collected source establishes rather than assuming a timezone. UTC or unknown-basis time does not establish the athlete's local time of day.

distance_m.description: Distance in metres, or null when unavailable from the collected source.

moving_time_s.description: Moving time in seconds, or null when unavailable from the collected source.

elapsed_time_s.description: Elapsed time in seconds, or null when unavailable from the collected source.

total_elevation_gain_m.description: Elevation gain in metres, or null when unavailable from the collected source.

average_heartrate.description: Average heart rate in beats per minute, or null when unavailable from the collected source. Browser summary records carry null until detail collection supplies heart-rate data.

max_heartrate.description: Maximum heart rate in beats per minute, or null when unavailable from the collected source. Browser summary records carry null until detail collection supplies heart-rate data.

calories_kcal.description: Calories in kilocalories as recorded by Strava, or null when unavailable from the collected source. Browser summary records carry null; detail records may also have null.

gear.description: The name of the bike or shoes used, or null when unassigned or unavailable from the collected source. Browser summary records carry null; detail collection may resolve the name from the owner's gear lists.

freshness.description: How this reading was collected: 'snapshot' for account-export records and 'live' for records read from the signed-in website. This identifies the collection method, not a promise of continuous refresh.

exported_at.description: When Strava generated the account-export archive, or null when its generation date cannot be determined. Always null for browser-collected records, which do not come from an account-export archive. The key is present for both collection methods.

reason_display_messages.covered_in_full: All Strava activities in the selected date range have already been collected.
reason_display_messages.collection_interrupted: Strava stopped answering partway through, so some activities are missing. The next run continues from where this one stopped.
reason_display_messages.nothing_in_range: Strava has no activities in the selected date range.
reason_display_messages.records_unreadable: Some activities in your Strava list couldn't be read and were skipped — everything else was collected normally.
reason_display_messages.sign_in_required: Strava needs you to sign in again before this can continue.
reason_display_messages.source_limit_reached: This run reached a source limit. The next run will retry the remaining activity work.
reason_display_messages.source_unreadable: Strava answered with a page this connector doesn't recognise, so nothing more was read. Strava may have changed its site — please report this rather than retrying.

pageshim.exception: Preserves the app's activities payload and STATE shape.
pageshim.login_message: Sign in to Strava, then return here.
